representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose the angle between force and displacement and calculate the signed parallel component.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State force magnitude and direction, displacement magnitude and direction, their included angle, and the resulting projection setup.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Sum force-specific work, update kinetic energy, and classify endpoint versus path-dependent work.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List initial kinetic energy, each force's signed work, net work, final kinetic energy, and any endpoint/path comparison.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Inventory kinetic, gravitational, and spring stores and balance them with any stated nonconservative work.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List initial and final values for K, Ug, Us, and signed nonconservative work using one consistent reference height.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Compare force-distance work, time-based power, and input-output efficiency as distinct quantities.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List input/output forces and distances, input/output work, elapsed time, mechanical advantage, and efficiency in separate rows.
